# SnowMyScreen

> A macOS desktop overlay app. Current Mac App Store release: snowfall and custom PNG images. The next seasonal update adds rain, autumn leaves, spring petals, summer fireflies and decorative lights.

The application runs on Mac; it is not an iPhone or iPad app, a weather forecast service, an audio app or a replacement for the macOS screensaver. Requirements: macOS 14.6 or later; confirm the available release on the Mac App Store.

## Product and support
- [Product, effects and FAQ](https://snowmyscreen.app/): Supported controls, overlay placement, custom images, multiple displays and release availability.
- [Setup and support](https://snowmyscreen.app/support/): Menu bar controls, PNG import limits and troubleshooting.
- [Privacy](https://snowmyscreen.app/privacy.html): Local settings and image storage.
- [Mac App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6755106853): Current available release.

## Guides
- [Desktop journal](https://snowmyscreen.app/blog/): Mac desktop customization guides.
- [How to add snow to your Mac desktop](https://snowmyscreen.app/blog/mac-desktop-effects/): Overlay setup and a guide to the upcoming seasonal update.
